claims.claim: TransDigm raised FY2026 sales guidance midpoint by $150M and EBITDA As Defined midpoint by $100M, citing stronger bookings; the new sales midpoint is about $10.51B and EBITDA As Defined midpoint $5.52B.

risks: higher selling and administrative expense and interest expense offset part of sales growth
pending acquisition contribution is excluded from current guidance and introduces execution uncertainty
contradictions: Raised guidance supports momentum, but EBITDA growth trails sales growth and margin is modestly lower year over year, so integration quality is a key falsifier.
unknowns: post-integration economics of pending and recent acquisitions

recommendation.reason: Guidance revisions create explicit execution benchmarks for underwriting without assigning numeric score authority.
